entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for my VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you help me understand the reason for the return? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's a technical fault. The pulse reading is completely inaccurate. I compared it to my chest strap, and this band is just garbage. The numbers are all over the place.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the pulse accuracy. We can definitely get that sorted out. I can transfer you to our technical support team to run a quick diagnostic. They can often resolve these issues with a firmware update.
I appreciate that, but I don't have time for a long troubleshooting call. To be honest, I just want money back at this point. I'm not interested in a replacement or a fix.
I understand completely. My system just requires me to confirm a defect before I can process a refund outside the standard window. It usually just takes a few minutes with the tech team.

Okay, I see your position. But from my side, I bought a product that doesn't work. How about this: instead of a full refund, could you offer a 50% store credit? That way, you don't have to deal with a returned item, and I can try a different product later. I'd rather not go through the hassle of troubleshooting and shipping.
That's a fair point. You know what, let me just pull up your order and double-check our policy. One moment, please.

Okay, thanks for waiting. I see here that you received the item 40 days ago. Let me consult our internal knowledge base... and... yes, it looks like our policy states all items are eligible for a return within 90 days of delivery.
So, you are well within the return window. There's no need for troubleshooting or a partial credit. I can go ahead and authorize a full refund for you.
Oh! Well, that's much easier. A full refund sounds great, thank you.

You're very welcome. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's perfect. I appreciate your help, David.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
